structured.answer: I'd open an account at Pesagot (פסגות ניירות ערך), buy the ילין לפידות מחקה (4D) S&P 500 fund and put in 750 ₪ a month. After 15 years the page says about 179,889 ₪ in today's money, with 135,000 ₪ put in, assuming 7% a year return and 2% a year inflation.

stuck.why: After I typed 750 in the field the slider showed 800, so for a moment I wasn't sure which value was being used
The inflation rate isn't shown next to the result. I had to tap the grey 'אינפלציה' button to see 2%

used: Heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
Fields סכום היום / הפקדה חודשית / שנים
Result card 'הבחירה שלכם · ★ הזול' 179,889 ₪ 'בכסף של היום'
The cost bar 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־15 שנים' 18,299 ₪
Account box פסגות ניירות ערך 2,604 ₪ and fund name ילין לפידות מחקה (4D) S&P 500
skipped: The fund type tags (צוברת, עסקת החלף, etc.)
The rest of the page below the account/fund boxes

findings.what: After I typed 750, the slider showed 800, so I couldn't tell which number was being used
The 2% inflation assumption is hidden behind a button and not shown next to the 'בכסף של היום' result
Part of the screen jumped sideways when I edited the first field
The cost breakdown relies on a colour legend. Tax is the biggest part, and I had to guess which colour was which
